market_read: Book opened with everything in cash. The first scheduled session will fetch live prices and decide where it goes. Standing brief: rates are the live risk — the Fed sits at 3.50–3.75% with a meaningful minority pricing a hike rather than a cut, driven by oil-fed inflation after the Hormuz disruption. That argues against long-duration growth and for cash-generative value. Leadership has already broadened out of technology into industrials, energy, staples and healthcare. Gold is 22% off its January record with sovereigns buying and ETFs selling. Nothing here is a technology thesis unless the numbers earn it.
